name: policydrift
description: PolicyDrift: full-stack news platform (Express + MySQL + Next.js 14)

scripts.feeds:check: dotenv -e .env.development -- cross-env NODE_ENV=development npm run feeds:check -w policydrift-backend
scripts.ingest: dotenv -e .env.development -- cross-env NODE_ENV=development npm run ingest -w policydrift-backend
scripts.trends: dotenv -e .env.development -- cross-env NODE_ENV=development npm run trends -w policydrift-backend
scripts.ingest:prod: dotenv -e .env.production -- cross-env NODE_ENV=production npm run ingest -w policydrift-backend
scripts.trends:prod: dotenv -e .env.production -- cross-env NODE_ENV=production npm run trends -w policydrift-backend
scripts.feeds:check:prod: dotenv -e .env.production -- cross-env NODE_ENV=production npm run feeds:check -w policydrift-backend
scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,magenta "npm run dev:api" "npm run dev:web"
scripts.dev:api: dotenv -e .env.development -- cross-env NODE_ENV=development npm run dev -w policydrift-backend
scripts.build:dev: dotenv -e .env.development -- cross-env NODE_ENV=production npm run build -w policydrift-frontend
scripts.build:prod: dotenv -e .env.production -- cross-env NODE_ENV=production npm run build -w policydrift-frontend
scripts.start:api: dotenv -e .env.production -- cross-env NODE_ENV=production npm run start -w policydrift-backend
scripts.start: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,magenta "npm run start:api" "npm run start:web"
